name: luleopard-mobile
description: 鹿豹 · 台灣道路測速預報 — Capacitor 打包（含背景定位）

scripts.sync: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync && npm run patch:android
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.add:android: npm run prepare:www && npx cap add android && npm run icons && npm run sync
scripts.add:ios: npm run prepare:www && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
